subject: docs/THREAT_MODEL.md
notes: M07-01 review checklist. For each named boundary the review records the assets at risk, the attack, the tested control, and the residual risk. A boundary with no tested control is a gap and must say so. This is an internal review artifact; it is NOT an independent audit, and no row claims the system is safe.

boundaries.control: rh_arg_safe allowlist + rh_url_kind before any call; exit 3 on rejection
boundaries.residual: allowlist is conservative; a new metachar would need a new byte added, not removed

boundaries.control: git log/rev-parse plumbing only; -c core.pager=cat; no checkout/archive
boundaries.residual: system(3) still uses a shell; arguments are allowlisted before the call

boundaries.control: rh_fetch_guard (scheme/host), bounded resolver, rh_addr_guard on the complete answer set, cURL --resolve pinning, user config and proxies disabled, no redirects, no Authorization header
boundaries.residual: no approved-host allowlist is enforced yet; address checks constrain routability but callers must limit production use to reviewed public APIs until an approval gate exists

boundaries.control: bounded JSON depth/nodes and RH_MAX_READ; Go ZIP caps archive/expanded bytes and entry count, validates CRC32, and fails closed without extraction

test.token: [artifact-observe] Go ZIP h1 verification emits rh-go-zip-observation-result/1

boundaries.residual: ZIP64, split archives, encryption, and expanded content above 64 MiB are unsupported; zlib is an OS-provided native dependency

boundaries.control: publication review patterns, suppression gate, no-score contract
boundaries.residual: the review is a pattern check, not a semantic proof; human review remains required

boundaries.control: loopback-only bind, allowlisted paths, method-before-path, no echo
boundaries.residual: single-threaded; --max bounds termination. No TLS (loopback only).

boundaries.control: rh_edge_visible visibility filter applied before enqueue
boundaries.residual: depends on callers supplying correct visibility arrays

not_covered: no independent third-party audit has been performed
no release signing keys exist (M07-04); digest verification is integrity only
no fuzzing harness beyond bounded-parser adversarial fixtures
